issues.title: Some orders never show up in the list
issues.body: When I page through `python3 -m orderdesk list`, order 3 is missing. All five orders should be listed.

issues.title: Tax is rounded down
issues.body: `python3 -m receipts total 1999` prints 2158. With 8% tax it is 2158.92, which rounds to 2159.
